questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign means no right turns are permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area. Be alert and ready to share the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use this lane. The sign shows how many people must be in the vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that bicycles cross or ride in this area. Drive slowly and carefully because cyclists are likely to be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve right and then curve left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Look carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you see this sign. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must always yield and wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to low clearance ahead. Tall vehicles may not fit under overhead structures in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right to cross at crosswalks. You must let them pass safely. Stay alert at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left. This is a hand signal used instead of turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended safe speed for exiting a highway. The number shown (like 30 mph) is a suggestion, not a requirement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop completely. Give the right-of-way to other vehicles and pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction are about to join into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two one-way roadways with a median between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage and collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a diamond-shaped warning sign with black markings on yellow. It alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The underside of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down to check for traffic and let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Stop only if necessary.
